notes.title: Champion Shift Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[i]Greetings Champions! New patch rolling through fixing some issues with the save data on older installs, as well as some needed balance changes to certain vehicular weapons. Also, more achievements![/i]

[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] New Steam Achievements for our latest Champion, Joan of Arc! [i]If you have already fulfilled these achievements, then Steam should grant them automatically. If you're not receiving them, please restart the Steam Client![/i]
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[i]The game was confusing an older data set with the new one, so every time you started the game, it would revert previously accomplished in-game achievements. We're very sorry for any inconveniences and frustration, the game should save and load all of your achievements correctly now.[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing issues with reading save data correctly. 
[/list]
[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]
[i]Some long awaited changes to the vehicle weaponry. We lowered the initial base value, by about 50%, and adjusted the scaling to be more in tune with other abilities. You will still be able to stack all of the guns and ram bosses till their demise, but you will have to do so with more than a couple of points invested in those abilities. We hope this encourages more variety in ability selection.[/i]

TECH ABILITIES
[list]
[*] Machine Gun: Damage adjusted to 45% [30% per level]
[*] Forward Guns: Damage adjusted to 55% [35% per level]
[*] Shotgun: Damage adjusted to 75% [40% per level]
[/list]
JESSE JAMES
[list]
[*] Outlaw Star: Damage adjusted to 75% [40% per level]
[/list]

[i]Thats all for now! We're aware of some issues occuring in multiplayer that we're looking to address, we hope to roll those fixes ASAP! Until then, keep on driving, Champions![/i]

notes.title: Champion Shift 1.1 Release Notes - Joan Of Arc Arrives!
notes.notes:
Greetings Champions!

We are super excited to release patch 1.1 which includes the long awaited arrival of the Divine Defender, Joan of Arc! This new Champion brings her might to the streets in the fight against the Dominion, with new and powerful abilities to crush the enemy forces.  Her kit ramps up with time in some very cool ways, and when fully upgraded in a run, Joan becomes a wrecking ball of divine power.  Here is a breakdown of her heroic abilities:

[b]ALLEZ![/b] 
Weapon attacks have a 25% chance to project a celestial lance, extending Joan of Arc's range. Weapon damage is increased by 50% [+25% per level].

[b]BARRAGE[/b]
Every 3rd auto attack fires a rapid sequence of strikes, hitting enemies for 50% Weapon DMG and has a 250% chance to MULTISHOT [+50% per level].

[b]EN GARDE[/b]
Perform a spin attack that knocks back enemies and deals 50% DMG, with a 50% chance to MULTICAST [+50% per level] generating a 3-second aura granting 15 armor for each cast.

[b]RIPOSTE[/b]
On dash, deliver a triple strike dealing 150% Weapon DMG [+75% per level], with a chance to trigger on-hit effects.

[b]REPRISE[/b]
On shift out, charge forward with a massive thrust dealing 150% Weapon DMG [+75% per level]. Gain +10 AGILITY for 3 seconds upon defeating an enemy.

[b]CONTRE ATTAQUE[/b]
On shift in, place a sigil for 3 seconds that impales enemies, dealing 100% Weapon DMG [+50% per level] and triggering on-hit effects.

[b]AUX ARMES[/b]
While in vehicle mode, energy lances out at enemies, dealing 100% Weapon DMG with a 250% MULTISHOT chance [+50% per level] and triggering on-hit effects.

----------------------------------

The update also includes miscellaneous bug fixes and improvements to game stability across the board, which should continue to minimize crashes in the game. As always, thanks to our awesome community on Discord for reporting bugs and suggesting improvements, we couldn't do this without you!

We hope you enjoy this new update, and see you in game!

-The SRG Team

notes.title: Champion Shift 0.9 Patch Notes - New Features!
notes.notes:
Greetings Champions!  The [b]biggest update[/b] ever in Champion Shift is here!
We are extremely excited to bring to you all some new features and content which we are really proud of, and we hope will make your game experience much more awesome.  So without further delay, here is the tiiiiiny changelog for this update 🙂

[b]NEW STAGE SELECTION FEATURE[/b]
To give players much more control over their gameplay sessions, we have added stage unlocking and stage selection, allowing players to, once unlocked, start from any biome/stage they wish, in both single player and multiplayer.

Also, at the end of each stage, players can select (and in the case of multiplayer, vote to) continue to the next biome, stay in the current biome, end the run, or the final boss fight once all 5 biomes have been completed.

[b]NEW STAGES[/b]
A total of 7 new stages have made their way into the game! New stages have been added to all biomes, each tied through quests to the new Relic system.

[b]RELICS[/b]
These powerful artifacts can be found by completing Relic Quests in each of the stages in the game, providing additional boosts to the player’s stats. Hint: Collect all Relics, and the Dominion CEO will not be pleased, he will take it very personally :)

[b]NEW CHAMPION: JESSE JAMES[/b]
The legendary cowboy Jesse James makes its way into the streets, brandishing powerful pistols and casting powerful undead summons. This Champion came out amazing and can’t wait for you all to try it!

[b]LOCALIZATION[/b]
The game is now available in English, Spanish, German, Portuguese, French, Italian, Chinese (simplified), Chinese (traditional), and Russian. This is a first pass at this, so if you find any errors or have suggestions for improving the wording in these languages, let us know in our Discord!

[b]DIFFICULTY[/b]
The game now has several difficulty modes to select from. Enemies will scale faster and present a greater challenge in higher difficulty modes. Test your skills and your ability to survive as you upgrade your Champions.

[b]NEW CELESTIAL GIFTS[/b]
We added 5 new Celestial Gift trees, each with unique abilities to power your Champions:

[list]
[*] Durendal
[*] Ixchel, Spiritwalker
[*] Surtur’s Touch
[*] Enlil’s Aid
[*] Enki’s Protection
[/list]

We’ll leave it to you all to discover each one in the game!

[b]SUMMONS[/b]
We have captured some Dominion tech! By gathering fragments, you can complete and summon powerful companions that will help you out in your quest to defeat the Dominion.

[b]NEW MUSIC[/b]
Alpine and Volcano biomes have all new music, as well as the final boss encounter! 

-----------------------------------------------------
[b]BALANCING AND MISC CHANGES[/b]

[i]ENEMIES[/i]

- Increased stage enemy max to 150
- Enemy agility/speed balancing based on the camera being farther
- Added no enemy variants to final boss fight

[i]GRUNT SOLDIERS[/i]

- These units will progressively get harder to kill as each stage progresses.
- All boss spawners will produce the toughest grunt soldiers for the stage.

[i]MARINE SOLDIERS[/i]

- Will now appear in ISLAND and MOUNTAIN stages instead of VOLCANO stages.
 - Several enemy units have been moved around as a result.

[i]FINAL BOSS STAGE[/i]

- All mini bosses have been added to the mini boss pool.

- Aerial Sniper and Killboy Bot have been added to the ADV UNIT spawner.


[b]CHAMPIONS[/b]

Due the new MULTISHOT and ARMOR stat modification, a general balance pass is in effect to move around stat points to allocate for these modifications

[i]ARTHUR[/i]
- CRIT DMG increased to 150%. Up from 125%
- ARMOR increased to 5. Up from 1
- MULTICAST increased by 10%. Up from 0

[i]ATHENA[/i]
- ARMOR increased to 10. Up from 5
- RECOVERY reduced to 110%. Down from 115%
- VELOCITY reduced to 100%. Down from 110%

[i]GILGAMESH[/i]
- MULTICAST Increased to 110%. Up from 100%

[i]JESSE JAMES[/i]

- REZ DEAD REVOLVERS: Reduced skeleton DMG to 20% WPN DMG (down from 100%)

[i]VEJIGANTE[/i]
- WPN DMG increased to 80%. Up from 60%
- RECOVERY reduced to 100%. Down from 110%
- AREA increased to 95%. Up from 85%
- MULTICAST reduced to 100%. Down from 110%.
- CHUPACABRA: Increased initial DMG to 200% (up from 150%)

[i]WUKONG[/i]

- AREA increased to 105%. Up from 95%

- TRICKSTER'S FURY
    - Trickster's Fury now has a chance to spawn a clone upon defeating an enemy with his weapon. No longer buffs ATK/MOV SPD on hit
    - Increased Weapon DMG increase to 40% [+20% per level], up from 20% [+10% per level]

[b]CELESTIAL GIFTS[/b]

- Switched out multicast stat into boons that will now use multishot stat. Added Multishot stat tp hero stat sheet

[i]NAGA VENOM[/i]

- We now have stackable effects in the game and we are trying it out with Naga Venom first. As long as the target receives another
- Reducing the POISON DMG to 6% DMG [+1% per level] with a duration of 3 seconds


[b]STATS[/b]

- Created the Multishot stat and added the required boons, stat upgrades, and allocation on the upgrade tree.
- Switched out multicast stat into boons that will now use multishot stat. Added Multishot stat tp hero stat sheet

[i]ARMOR[/i]
- New ARMOR formula that will now mitigate a % of damage rather than a flat value, increasing this stat has diminishing returns. In response HP stat upgrades are being reduced to take effective health into consideration.

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]

- Removed a duplicated Wukong achievement (Tricksters Fury)
- Added a missing Gilgamesh Achievement (Burning Chains)
- Re-ordered Champion Skill achievements


[b]MISSIONS[/b]

[i]CONTAINMENT[/i]

- CONTROL POINTS is now called CONTAINMENT
- The objective is to "Contain the Infestation"

[i]PRIORITY TARGETS[/i]

- INFESTATION is now called PRIORITY TARGETS
- Will eventually change the spawn config for this mission

[i]DISRUPT COMMUNICATIONS[/i]

- DISRUPT COMMUNICATIONS now spawns advanced units instead of mini bosses
- The comm towers now have two variants that each have an orbital attack
- Comm Tower A: Calls in Orbital lasers that slowly track towards the players
- Comm Tower B: Calls in a barrage of laser beams upon the player
- Both tower variants will discharge an energy repulsion field when attacked.

[b]YGGDRASIL UPGRADES[/b]

- Max Speed Stat Boost reduction
- Max Speed I now awards +2 Max Speed, down from +4
- Max Speed II now awards +3 Max Speed, down from +6


Whew! That’s a lot, and we thank you for sticking with us through this update :) Remember, join our Discord so you can join the conversation, let us know of any bugs you encounter, or just drop in and say hi!

Much love,
The SRG Team

notes.title: Champion Shift 0.6.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Champions! 
We are super excited to bring you the long awaited update to our in-game missions!  Here is a detailed breakdown of everything going on in this patch, which features some content, lots of fixes, re-balancing and everything in between:

[b]NEW MISSIONS[/b]
We added 4 new mission types, which will bring new mechanics and challenges to your runs. 

[b]Spy Drone[/b] - a Dominion drone has been spotted, he is pretty fast! Catch up to him and destroy it.
[b]Demolition[/b] - the Dominion has constructed missile emplacements, which you need to destroy with bombs scattered across the map
[b]Artifact Retrieval[/b] - retrieve the mysterious objects being held captive by Dominion forces, and deliver them to The Hand.
[b]Control Points[/b] - hold off against waves of enemies as you fight to dominate control points scattered through the map


[b]NEW BOSS FIGHT[/b]
[b]TR-3Y[/b]:  Brace yourself for this deadly new Dominion creation, a formidable new adversary awaiting your arrival, armed to the teeth and ready to test your skills.


[b]CHAMPIONS RE-BALANCE[/b]
	After a month of having the Champions out in the wild and gathering valuable data and feedback, we're reworking their stats. A big thank you to all our players who have enjoyed Champion Shift so far; we've been listening, and more adjustments and features are on the way. For now, we'll be adjusting the Champions' stats to reduce the dramatic swings between their highs and lows. The floor for a champion's base initial stats will be set at 80%, and the ceiling at 120%. This change will allow us to implement things like curses to lower some stats, and also bring some buffs under control. We still want players to find ways to optimize their stats, but it will now require a bit more effort. This isn't the only modification to Champions; there's another change we'll be making in a future update. Apart from their weapons, stats are another way we differentiate between one champion and another. notes.title: Champion Shift 0.6.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Champions!

Got a ton of fixes and improvements for you today, including our resident best boy, the Chupacabra, and a new starting Celestial Gift, the WINGS OF QUETZALCOATL, which is sure to create more havoc with its tornado creating powers. Also, the power of invincibility when you revive, because getting nuked the instant you do is well... let's just leave it at not fun, shall we? Anyway... we also have some balancing and quality of life improvements, so make sure to check it out below![/i]

[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
[list]
[*] New starting Celestial Gift: [b]WINGS OF QUETZALCOATL[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]DIVINE WIND -[/b] Unleash a swirling gust of wind that slowly moves across the battlefield, dealing 50% DMG [+25% per level] for 5 seconds.
[*] [b]RESPLENDENT WINGS -[/b] Increase DURATION by 2 seconds per level and passing through tornadoes reduces DASH cooldown and applies a brief AGILITY boost.
[*] [b]COATL'S BREATH -[/b] Increase the size of the Serpent's Breath by 30% AREA [+15% per level] and enemies killed by it release fast moving  wind projectiles that deal 50% DMG.
[/list]
[*] Vejigante's Chupacabra ability is now back in the game.
[*] Champions now have 2 seconds of invincibility after reviving.
[*] Fixed an issue with Origata, Moon Beam, Falcon of the Sun and Chakram where their formulas weren't calculating damage correctly.
[*] New visual for when the champion is not able to shift into vehicle form.
[*] Fixed issues with champion and vehicle colliders.
[*] Fixed the Health Celestial Gift description to correctly indicate 200 HP (It always gave 200, but the description was incorrect).
[*] Fixed Starfire Arrows from sometimes not firing.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Earth Elite stone pillar visual spawning in a different area (Invisible stones be damned!).
[*] Missions should now spawn enemies that are more specific for the current stage.
[*] Fixed scroll sensitivity in the user interface with controller.
[*] New lore descriptions for some Celestial Gifts, providing more insight into the inner workings of the Dominion Corporation.
[*] Rabbit's Elixir duration is now properly affected by the DURATION stat.
[*] Fixed Vejigante's car speed formula.
[*] Gilgamesh's Sunburst description should now correctly display the amount of MULTICAST it gives.
[*] More collider fixes to Mountain Pass South and Magma Cave.
[/list]
[h3]BALANCING[/h3]
[b]CELESTIAL GIFTS[/b]
[i]THE LEGEND OF CHANG'E overall has been out performing other celestial gifts due to its (pretty awesome) buffing capabilities, so we're toning it down to bring it back to its intended level of power.[/i]

[b]GODDESS OF THE MOON[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced initial block chance to 10% (down from 15%).
[/list]
[b]MOON BEAM[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the damage to 30% & 15% per level (down from 40% and 20% per level).
[/list]
[b]RABBIT'S ELIXIR[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced buff duration to 3 seconds (down from 5 seconds).
[*] Reduced the AREA buff to +50% (down from +100%).
[/list]
[b]AREA STAT GIFT[/b]
[i]We're taking a close look at AREA and will be tweaking it further over the next few weeks. We're all for "Breaking the Game", but not your PCs and eyes![/i]
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of stacks you can have of this Gift to 4 (down from 10).
[/list]
[h3]MISSIONS[/h3]
[b]CELESTIAL RIFTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the minimum amount of elite enemies that spawn to 2 on stage 1, increasing by 1 each stage. The actual amount spawned will depend on the amount of enemies currently alive in the stage.
[/list]
[b]INFESTATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased spawn amount by 15%.
[*] Added large enemies to the mission spawner.
[/list]
[h3]ENEMIES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mini Boss (Large enemies) spawn rate reduction:
[*] Increased the cost of Mini-Bosses to 100 (up from 60).
[*] Increased the cost of Elite Mini-Bosses to 500 (up from 300).
[*] Reduced the spawn rate of ranged enemies.
[/list]
[i]With the new vehicle stat gifts and upgrades, such as CAPACITY and REGEN, energy stayed near 100% for most of the run, making it a useless resource, which is not intended. This change should be a step in the right direction to make vehicle energy a valuable resource that shouldn't be taken for granted (I see you turret XP farmers ;) ). If you want to make a vehicle-heavy run, you can still do so, but you wont be able to wholly ignore energy anymore![/i]
[list]
[*] Doubled enemy collision damage.
[/list]
[h3]VEHICLES[/h3]
[i]This change is temporary until we implement a more robust solution to the magnet. It should help with the frustrations of losing XP or having to go back to pick it up when moving at faster speeds.[/i]
[list]
[*] Increased vehicle pick-up magnet by 25%.
[/list]
[i]More features and content to come in our road to 1.0, so stay tuned! Until next time, keep driving Champions![/i]

notes.title: Champion Shift Update 0.6.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Champions!

With all the busy patching and hunting down bugs these past few days, the patch notes announcement here for last Friday’s build was delayed a bit, so here it is!

—---------------------------------------------------

Today’s update has a lot of quality-of-life fixes, more crash fixes and performance improvements. To start with, we’ve increased the size of “invisible walls” around the intended paths that players take, so there should be little to none of those “flying at top speed off a ramp and landing in lava crashing the game” situations. Instead, you should slam on an invisible wall and fall safe and sound where you should be. If any of these issues recur, please don’t hesitate to let us know and we’ll take care of it!

The final Dominion Boss was also something we looked at, and even with the latest change in VFX, we felt he still got lost in the battlefield, so we gave him a modest sizing. He should be much easier to follow now.

As far as performance is concerned, we’ve taken a look at a couple of things, including the speed at which the save data is read and saved, shader and material improvements, FPS improvements on enemy spawning, stage optimization, and changes to the graphics API.

We’ve also fixed issues with currency and achievement rewards, player revival with mouse and keyboard, UI fixes, and a smattering of others. Check the full list below:

[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
The Revive button when using the mouse and keyboard should now properly revive the player.
Reduced out-of-bounds situations by properly blocking flying vehicles.
Increased the size of the final Dominion Boss by 20%.

[h3]HEROES[/h3]
[b]VEJIGANTE[/b]
NOTE: We are aware of the issues with Chupacabra and are working to fix them. He’s been a bad puppy, but we’ll have him trained and following the Hero properly faster than you can say… well… we’ll just train him up ASAP ;)
Vejigante will now properly unlock for all players in a multiplayer run when the final Dominion Boss has been defeated, regardless of who is currently dead or who gets the killing blow.

[h3]PERFORMANCE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized save data read/write speed for faster loading after runs. This was done by removing gift specific stats from other players in multiplayer, so for now you will see 0 damage when you switch players. This will be corrected on a later patch.
[*] Optimized enemy pools in order to significantly reduce FPS drops during spawning.
[*] Optimized shaders and materials on multiple stages.
[*] Optimized assets in the Downtown and North District stages to improve loading times.
[*] Improved Gift selection speed in both single player and multiplayer.
[*] Force the game to use Direct3D 11 for improved stability and performance across the board. Once we have tried and tested other APIs such as Direct3D 12 or Vulkan, we’ll enable them.
[/list]
[h3]REWARDS[/h3]
[list]
[*] There was an issue where only the player who got the killing blow on the mini-boss and/or the stage boss received the currency for it. This is not by design, so we changed it so that everyone can get those much-needed upgrades.
[*] Everyone in the run should now be properly rewarded with shards and dust.
[/list]
Crashes are down to a minimum, but they can still happen. Please let us know if you experience these and we'll be on top of them!

Until next time, keep on driving, Champions!

notes.title: Release Notes for Update 0.4.4
notes.notes:
Greetings Champions!
We have done a few updates to Champion Shift during this last week and we’ll continue to do so in this upcoming week, to iron out all the bugs and fixes we have identified, in large part to the community and their feedback. We appreciate it immensely! Although there’s been two minor version updates since, we’re going to consolidate the changes in this post, and we’ll work harder to maintain more precise release notes with each update of the Prologue build. 🙂 Here are some of the recent changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] An initial version of graphic settings was introduced and now players can choose from three quality settings. We are detecting your video card to predict what setting is best, but feel free to adjust if framerate is an issue. In future updates, expect better framerates in all categories, as performance optimizations is a continual process.
[*] Game balance for enemies was addressed, with a smoother start and a more challenging experience in later stages.
[*] Added a new boss encounter in stage 4, and as we continue to add new boss encounters we’ll revise the current ones to maintain parity. A new enemy type was also added to the Desert stage.
[*] Fixed an issue with enemy teleporting where it caused unnecessary flickering. This is still a work on progress to be able to spread out enemies as best as possible among all players in co-op.
[*] Various UI fixes.
[*] Fixed an issue with Achievements where even though the unlock was granted, the list of completed Achievements wouldn’t update properly.
[*] Introduced a fix to minimize players teleporting through the ground when dashing into bigger enemies. 
[*] An optimization was made in the auto attack logic for enemies, which should improve performance a bit when large amounts of enemy soldiers are on screen.
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause players to not be able to load the game due to some database dependencies not being present.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial stage dialogue would not load properly on lower end PCs.
[*] And a ton more small fixes and improvements!
[/list]

Of note, we are aware of a small subset of players which are having trouble launching the game, we are investigating and will upload fixes asap. We are also aware of update download size issues, and are aiming to reduce it as much as possible in the next few weeks. As always, be sure to drop in our Discord and give us your feedback or to report any issues found. See you guys soon and thanks for playing!

- The SRG Team

notes.title: Champion Shift: Developer Update and Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Today the journey towards the full version of the game begins with the release of the Champion Shift Demo, and new gameplay trailer!  Make sure to download it, take it for a spin, and join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/championshift]Discord[/url].  At SRG Studios we are incredibly excited to welcome you all to our community, listen to your feedback and suggestions, and together make Champion Shift into something special.

[h3]Project Roadmap[/h3]
As we traverse the road to a 1.0 release, many milestones lay ahead, and we can’t wait to tackle them head on.  To give you all a glimpse of what is to come, we are releasing our first version of Champion Shift’s roadmap, which will be updated as more content is added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44055360/8970ccd2a874dcb61662e27ee98a0976934555bd.jpg[/img]

Let’s break it down a bit.  The first thing we have to mention is that Champion Shift will feature online CO-OP, and as action-roguelike players ourselves, we are really pumped about this. To get the game there, we are currently in the process of incorporating some pretty cool networking technology (more info soon!). This co-op feature will be included in our Champion Shift: Prologue build, which is slated for release in September 2023.

The Prologue will bring us closer to a more complete version of the game, with more features, unlocks, Champions, Celestial Gifts and stages!  This is our main focus right now, and all your feedback in regards to the demo will greatly impact our assessment of the fun-factor of the game (Reminder: Join our [url=https://discord.gg/championshift]Discord[/url]!).

The next stop on our journey will be our Early Access, starting in November 2023, followed by the full 1.0 release of the game in February 2024.  The full game will have some pretty cool community features, that we will be talking about more in the upcoming months, but suffice to say that players will be able to compete in tournaments and leaderboards, with some surprising game modes thrown in.  It is still in its early phases, but we are designing it to be a fun and worthwhile experience for our players.  

Our decade’s long journey as a game development studio has brought us here, and we can’t wait to keep showing you the development process of Champion Shift, its characters, locations, story, and tons of abilities. We want to see the community wrecking the Dominion, cycling multiple times to the end boss, getting a billion upgrades and completely breaking the game.

See you around!
